name: @agentfuse/embeddings-local
description: Optional local (on-device) embedding backend for AgentFuse semantic loop detection.
//: TODO(phase-4): this block stays empty until phase 4. It then gains onnxruntime-node (~301 MB of platform binaries — the reason this package is split out and loaded by dynamic import rather than being a dependency of the CLI), @huggingface/tokenizers for the WordPiece/BPE pass, and @agentfuse/core for the embedding port type. Nothing else: this package is a leaf and must never be imported statically from agentfuse or @agentfuse/proxy.
